lado_card.texto: The G1 from MuJoCo Menagerie and GMR retargeting, on CPU. Tested with mujoco 3.16.0, Menagerie 62ab00f, and GMR bb1bbe4 on 10/19/2026.

inicio.kicker: FTH — Humanoid Technology Training · course 3 of 5 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Whole body: imitate, teleoperate, and obey
inicio.lead: A useful humanoid doesn't just walk: it copies a human gesture, follows a VR operator, and carries out what a VLA tells it to do. In eight lessons you build this layer on the simulated G1: you read motion capture, do the retargeting with GMR, play it back, teleoperate, measure the hand, and check the whole chain. All on CPU, no robot.
inicio.capa_alt: Industrial humanoid robot with a dark visor on a lab gantry, raising its arm, with the title Whole body.
inicio.aulas_sub: From the three control layers to the end-to-end project: human motion as data, retargeting, motion tracking, teleoperation, hands, and the command that comes from a VLA.

itens: You write Python, have seen ROS 2, and have done (or read) FTH courses 0 to 2.
You don't own a humanoid: the practice runs in MuJoCo, on CPU, in seconds. No GPU needed.
You want to understand what sits underneath a VLA on a legged robot: the layer that executes.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Read a motion capture clip and tell whether you can use it.
Bring human motion to the G1 with GMR, without going past any joint's limit.
Measure why following angles isn't enough, and the effect of latency on teleoperation.
Check a mocap → retargeting → motion tracking → safety chain before sending anything to a robot.
